Added Info Bank function. New collection items completed in any run will be recorded, and can be viewed at any time through the game menu - Info Bank. At the same time, the new collection items in the Info Bank will provide Points, which can be exchanged for special story clearance rewards, and will be directly inherited in all subsequent runs. The original Gallery will exist as a sub-feature of Info Bank.

New function: In the trade interface of guild, any ship belonging to the guild can be assigned for automatic trading or transportation. Monthly trade settlement and fleet trade records are added for viewing at any time.

New function: hiring sailors has been added, and veterans with different abilities can be hired in taverns to join the team. Sailors are competent for various positions in the fleet, and can assist in expeditions and interpret books.
New function: Now the barmaids can inquire about the location information of most fleets in the area.
New function: NPC at sea will now actively initiate a negotiation request. After accepting the negotiation and completing the request, you can get a gift from the NPC.

A new notoriety system has been added. Actively attacking non-pirate NPCs will increase the regional notoriety. After the notoriety reaches a certain level, it will cause hostility from the NPCs in the region. Notoriety can be cleared by paying a fine at the Governor's Office.
Added a custom marker function, you can set up to 8 markers on the world map, and the markers will be displayed synchronously on the navigation mini-map.
Added a reminder that the shipbuilding is completed in the world map interface.
New function: When modifying ships in the shipyard, ships in the dock can be chosen and modified directly.
Added the display effect of assigning sailor interface, the magnifying glass button remains on when displaying ship information.
New: Can gain EXP when discovering new ports.

New function: Now in Chronicle, corresponding historical event records will be unlocked along with the progress of the story mission. The original Chronicle Completion Rewards has been cancelled, and the relevant blueprints can be purchased directly in the Ship Material Store.

releases.displayName: Dark Graphic (except UI) self-help before patch

items.text: Thank you for your support and criticism, as well as bug submissions. We are working hard to fix the problem and consider appropriate optimization solutions.

Regarding the problem of the game’s dark screen (except UI) problem, we are investigating the cause, but in most cases, it can be solved by adjusting the “screen brightness” in the screenshot below to 50!
Sorry for causing you trouble, we will continue to solve the problem and release patches, thank you again for your support!

3. Bug Fixed: Irregular move trajectory of support ship after recruiting it.
4. Bug Fixed: Irregular battle ending issue when fleeing from specific battles.
5. Bug Fixed: Misalignment of interaction focusing in the Ship Modification interface
6. Bug Fixed: A few text bugs
